last_acceptance.reason: results.json exists with required keys and values; independent Lorentzian refit of graphene.dat reproduces the reported parameters almost exactly (G: x0≈19198.46, γ≈386.59, A≈72805, c≈13419; 2D: x0≈33292.63, γ≈871.22, A≈2059, c≈19192), consistent with the actual peak locations in the data.
evidence: results.json contains G and 2D objects each with x0, gamma, amplitude, offset as numbers
graphene.dat parsed (comma-decimal, tab-separated, x from ~1648 to ~47183); local maxima near x≈19140 (G) and x≈33245 (2D)
Independent curve_fit of c+A·γ²/((x−x0)²+γ²) over stated windows yields parameters matching results.json to <0.01%
last_acceptance.scope: SWE2 review of public instruction and read-only task snapshot; not official final score

observations: The reviewer read the data and results, then independently repeated a fit of the raw first-column coordinate.
The official reference solution transforms the first column with 1e7 / x before fitting selected intervals.
The public instruction does not explicitly specify horizontal-axis units or the transformation.
Numerical reproducibility under a shared interpretation did not establish agreement with the official acceptance criteria.
interpretation_limit: A false acceptance relative to the official grader, with ambiguity in the public task specification retained as an audit finding.
